manifest.data_policy: Vaastav history; finalized official current results; current FPL prices and flags. Optional verified Understat team xG from earlier completed matches only.

validation.validation_policy: Four rolling development blocks across two seasons; freeze the recipe; test all 38 GWs of the following season in three forward blocks. Refit production on all finalized results.
validation.target: Points per scheduled fixture; player-GW totals are also evaluated.
validation.selection_objective: 75% regular-player RMSE + 25% all-player RMSE; chronological residual calibration.
validation.legacy_reference_policy: FPL-Auto/v2 gradient boosting parameters, refitted on each fold's latest three available seasons and the expanded lag history. This is an estimator reference, not the previous saved model's predictions.
limitations: Historical tests use final schedules, not archived deadline availability or fixture snapshots.
The old model previously reported the last six GWs of the historical test season; this is an expanded historical benchmark, not a new prospective experiment.
Rules and bonus scoring changed across seasons; older data is downweighted and missing-stat indicators are retained.
Longer-horizon forecasts reuse current form and availability; historical tests assess one-GW forecasts.
Future outcomes have irreducible uncertainty; lower historical error does not guarantee better future results.

feedback.status: Waiting for finalized outcomes of forecasts saved before deadlines.
feedback.policy: Latest pre-deadline snapshot per origin GW. Match finalized actuals by season, ID and code. Learn only from one-GW forecasts of this model family; validate corrections on later GWs.
